name: agent
description: Minimal v1 primitives for AI/LLM agents: agent_thread (Conversation), agent_message (Message with TextPart + ToolPart in jsonb parts), and agent_task (Task). Tool state and approvals live inside ToolPart on the message; embeddings, runs/steps, annotations, tool-call rows and tool-approval rows are intentionally deferred. Entity-scoped via DataOwnershipInEntity on agent_thread; descendants inherit entity_id via DataInheritFromParent.

tables.description: Top-level AI/LLM conversation. Owns the chat-mode + model + system-prompt snapshot for the lifetime of the conversation, and is the entity-scoping anchor — descendants (agent_message, agent_task) inherit entity_id from this row via DataInheritFromParent. RLS is owner-only (AuthzDirectOwner); entity_id is a grouping dimension, not a security dimension.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Human-readable conversation title. Typically auto-generated from the first user message and editable by the user. NULL until a title has been computed.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Conversation mode: 'ask' for plain Q&A (no tool execution) or 'agent' for tool-enabled execution. Stored as free-text (no CHECK) so new modes can be added without migration.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Snapshot of the LLM model id this thread is bound to (e.g. 'gpt-5', 'claude-sonnet-4'). Captured on creation so a resumed conversation stays on the same model even if app defaults change. NULL means use the app default at request time.

fields.name: system_prompt
fields.description: Snapshot of the system prompt active for this thread. Stored on the thread (rather than referenced from a registry) so the conversation remains reproducible even if a future system_prompt registry changes its canonical text. NULL means use the app default at request time.

tables.description: A single message in an agent_thread. The full client-rendered content (TextPart and ToolPart, including the ToolPart state machine and inline approval object) lives in the `parts` jsonb column — there is no separate agent_tool_call or agent_tool_approval table in v1. Cascade-deleted with the parent thread; RLS is owner-only.

fields.name: thread_id
fields.description: Foreign key to agent_thread. Required; the FK constraint and cascade-delete behaviour are declared in the blueprint's relations[]. Declared explicitly in fields[] (rather than left for RelationBelongsTo to create) so that the DataInheritFromParent generator can validate this field exists when it provisions the entity_id-inheritance trigger.

fields.name: entity_id
fields.description: Entity (org/group/personal-org id) this message is filed under. Populated automatically by the DataInheritFromParent BEFORE INSERT trigger, which copies it from agent_thread.entity_id via thread_id; the application never sets this column directly. Used for org-scoped grouping queries (e.g. 'all my messages in org X'), NOT for RLS — RLS is owner-only.

fields.name: author_role
fields.description: Who authored this message: 'user' or 'assistant'. Stored as free-text (no CHECK) so additional roles can be introduced without migration. Tool inputs/outputs do NOT get their own role — they appear as ToolPart entries inside the assistant message's `parts` array.

tables.description: An agent- or user-authored todo item attached to an agent_thread. Captures the planning surface for agent-mode conversations: each row is a single discrete unit of work with a status lifecycle (pending → in-progress → done|failed). Cascade-deleted with the parent thread; RLS is owner-only.

fields.name: thread_id
fields.description: Foreign key to agent_thread. Required; the FK constraint and cascade-delete behaviour are declared in the blueprint's relations[]. Declared explicitly in fields[] (rather than left for RelationBelongsTo to create) so that the DataInheritFromParent generator can validate this field exists when it provisions the entity_id-inheritance trigger.

fields.name: entity_id
fields.description: Entity (org/group/personal-org id) this task is filed under. Populated automatically by the DataInheritFromParent BEFORE INSERT trigger from agent_thread.entity_id via thread_id; the application never sets this column directly.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Natural-language description of the work to do. Required.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Who created the task: 'agent' (added by the LLM during planning) or 'user' (added manually by the human). Stored as free-text (no CHECK) so additional sources can be introduced later.

fields.name: error
fields.description: Error message captured when the task transitioned to 'failed'. NULL while the task is still pending/in-progress, or when it completed successfully.
